key_insight: PACT formalizes token-level credit with three axioms and uses that insight to align critic training with the updated policy for stronger RL post-training.
engineering_relevance: For LLM and agent training pipelines, PACT offers a more principled actor-critic update rule that can improve optimization stability and downstream task performance.
method: Define token-level credit via Completeness, Prefix Consistency, and Neutrality.
Show links between this credit notion and OPD, RLOO, and GAE signals.
Use Actor-then-Critic updates with importance sampling to better align the critic to the new policy.
evidence_signal: The abstract reports gains on agentic math reasoning (72.87% average accuracy across four benchmarks) and SWE-bench Verified (67.4% pass rate), outperforming PPO, GRPO, and SAO.
watch_item: The approach depends on accurate importance-sampling correction and critic updates, which may be sensitive to policy shift and critic estimation error.
paper_title: PACT: From Credit Assignment to Critic Alignment
